verdict.rationale: Ardent is a Postgres branching and cloning tool, so scheduled backups and self-serve restore are a fair axis for it. The evidence covers only instant isolated branches, deletion locks and quarantine release. None of these is a visible, configurable backup schedule or a documented restore flow; they are adjacent features at most.

support.subject: As a founder, automatic backups run on a schedule I can see and configure, and restores are self-serve
